text: I'm tired supporting these two for no good. Give me twenty-two dollars for this one, and I'll throw the other one in.” The king couldn't get his breath, he was in such a fury. He began to choke and gag, and meantime the master and the gentleman moved away discussing. “An ye will keep the offer open--” “'Tis open till the morrow at this hour.” “Then I will answer you at that time,” said the gentleman, and disappeared, the master following him. I had a time of it to cool the king down, but I managed it.

provenance.work: A Connecticut Yankee in King Arthur's Court
provenance.author: Mark Twain
